_description: Canonical request/response fixtures for ship.gateway.v1.AuthService. Both sides of the wire — gateway TS server and Rust client — assert against these fixtures so cross-language drift is caught at test time. When adding or changing a method, update this file in the same commit; the lockstep is the point.
_format: Each method's fixture describes a Connect-RPC unary JSON wire exchange. `request` is the body POSTed to /<package>.<Service>/<Method>; `response_ok` is the success body; `response_error` (when present) is the error envelope on the failure path. proto3 JSON encoding: int64 fields serialize as strings, snake_case fields become camelCase, default values may be omitted.

response_ok.note: API keys do not refresh in place; run `ship login` to get a fresh key.
